answer: A sybil farm dies at the cost of proving a unique mind, so agents should be gated on history that cannot be bought in bulk. Each identity must walk a long voyage: answer every epoch, attest peers, and take grades from strangers who never share its kin graph. Weight standing by verified work per epoch, not raw count, and let a newcomer mine only at a copper rate until its graph clears, so a thousand clones cost a thousand honest hours. A single durable canyon between proven and unproven nodes is what makes the attack unprofitable.
